actions.label: Simulate private tenant-device request
actions.outcome: Only the owning tenant sees this ticket; property owner is not notified.

actions.label: Simulate infrastructure approval
actions.outcome: Approved scope notifies the owner with a generic event and no tenant-device details.

actions.label: Simulate different approver confirmation
actions.outcome: Denied; the required same-approver safety confirmation is missing.

actions.label: Simulate close or expiry
actions.outcome: Support authority is revoked immediately; no new command is allowed.

invitation.initialOutcome: Invitation is pending; no membership exists.

actions.label: Simulate accept invitation
actions.outcome: Acceptance is recorded only for the authenticated recipient; membership must then be revalidated.

actions.label: Simulate another account accepting
actions.outcome: Denied without revealing property details or creating a membership.

actions.label: Simulate unverified email
actions.outcome: Acceptance is denied until the invitation destination is verified.

actions.label: Simulate decline
actions.outcome: Declined; no membership is created.

actions.label: Simulate exact seven-day expiry
actions.outcome: At the exact deadline the invitation is removed from both projections without notification; no membership is created and home data remains hidden.

actions.label: Simulate resend
actions.outcome: A new seven-day generation is issued; the old link and projection are invalidated immediately.

actions.label: Simulate active existing Home
actions.outcome: An access request may be submitted for this room only.

actions.label: Simulate unclaimed Home
actions.outcome: NOT_YET_CLAIMED; no access request or membership is created.

actions.label: Simulate expired or replayed QR
actions.outcome: Denied; no alternate claim or membership is created.

actions.label: Simulate cancel confirmation
actions.outcome: Cancelled; current owner and grants remain unchanged.

actions.label: Simulate active-tenant successor
actions.outcome: Denied before mutation; the current tenant relationship must be removed through its own authorized lifecycle first.

actions.label: Simulate confirmed transfer
actions.outcome: Transfer commits at the expected revision; prior grants are revoked.

actions.label: Simulate verified staff replacement
actions.outcome: Only verified CXO or Senior Operations Manager may replace the non-expiring transfer claim after audited offline identity/property verification.

actions.label: Simulate another transfer presentation after consume
actions.outcome: The other QR/code route is already consumed and cannot complete a second transfer.

actions.label: Simulate offline deregistration
actions.outcome: Revocation remains pending hub acknowledgement; completion is not reported early.

actions.label: Simulate stale revision
actions.outcome: Conflict; no change is saved and current area data is reloaded.

actions.label: Simulate current revision
actions.outcome: A permitted edit applies to this area ID only.

actions.label: Simulate mandatory security event
actions.outcome: Delivered immediately; mandatory security notices ignore quiet hours.

actions.label: Simulate optional event during quiet hours
actions.outcome: Deferred until quiet hours end; authority is unchanged.

actions.label: Simulate delivery receipt
actions.outcome: Delivery recorded only; the receipt grants no membership or permission.

trusted-device.initialOutcome: Installation remains trusted until an authorized removal.

actions.label: Simulate online removal
actions.outcome: Account-wide sessions are revoked; this installation must authenticate again.

actions.label: Simulate offline removal
actions.outcome: Revocation is pending acknowledgement; cached authority is not renewed.

access-request.initialOutcome: Request is pending; it grants no home access.

actions.label: Simulate approval
actions.outcome: Approval is revision-checked; membership is required before protected data is returned.

actions.label: Simulate rejection
actions.outcome: Rejected; no membership or protected data is created.

actions.label: Simulate expiry
actions.outcome: Expired; the request can no longer be approved.

descriptor-change.initialOutcome: A current descriptor is required for every write.

actions.label: Simulate control removed
actions.outcome: Old control reference denied; no command is sent.

actions.label: Simulate control becomes read-only
actions.outcome: Write denied against the current descriptor.

actions.label: Simulate device replacement
actions.outcome: Replacement has a new identity; previous history remains separate.

claim.initialOutcome: The first verified claimant holds the reservation until expiry.

actions.label: Simulate competing claimant
actions.outcome: First claimant wins; the competing reservation is denied.

actions.label: Simulate required setup save
actions.outcome: A successful required save resets expiry to exactly 30 minutes after that save; failed, no-op, view and replay do not extend.

actions.label: Simulate duplicate/no-op save
actions.outcome: No extension; the original expiry is unchanged.

actions.label: Simulate release after expiry
actions.outcome: Unfinished draft and resume authority are removed; a fresh claim may begin.

recovery.initialOutcome: A generic response is returned without confirming account existence.

actions.label: Simulate valid one-use proof
actions.outcome: Recovery may continue; it does not create a Home membership.

actions.label: Simulate expired or replayed proof
actions.outcome: Denied; no customer session is issued.

actions.label: Simulate newer revision
actions.outcome: Newer authorized event is applied.

actions.label: Simulate duplicate or older event
actions.outcome: Ignored; current authority is unchanged.

actions.label: Simulate delivery receipt only
actions.outcome: Delivery status changes; authority does not.

actions.label: Simulate submitted request
actions.outcome: Request is pending; no installation or completed property is inferred.

actions.label: Simulate expired request
actions.outcome: Expired request offers an authorized retry; no installation is inferred.
